title: ApprovedCuts v1
description: A human-approved list of time ranges to remove from one recorded video, consumed by the `apply-cuts` CLI. Only explicitly approved CUT ranges belong here; REVIEW ranges and un-approved silences must not be included. A conservative safety margin shrinks every cut inward so a dry cut never clips a word. `apply-cuts` also accepts a `cut-review.json` directly (it takes the segments whose suggestion is CUT), so this file is optional.
